findings.quote: Paper is an insulator, but its atoms still shift.
findings.problem: This gives the wrong mechanism for polarization. The positive and negative charge distributions within atoms or molecules shift relative to each other. Moving whole neutral atoms does not produce the charge separation that explains the paper's attraction.
findings.source: [OpenStax, College Physics 2e, Section 18.2, Figure 18.14 and accompanying explanation](https://openstax.org/books/college-physics-2e/pages/18-2-conductors-and-insulators)
